entries.title: Growing Decision Forest
entries.description: A central translucent sphere emits branching rods that split recursively into a glowing 3D tree of colored nodes, where each branch point is a labeled sphere that can grow, shrink, or fade as “decisions” propagate as moving particles along the branches.

entries.title: Binary Split Machine
entries.description: A stream of small balls falls from above onto a 3D array of hinged paddles that automatically rotate left or right to simulate binary decisions, sending the balls down branching chutes to labeled bins whose fill level is shown with transparent columns.
